changelog:
Initial release of Google Maps Reviews Analyzer.

- Analyze Google Maps review data from CSV exports—no API key required.
- Features: sentiment analysis, trend detection, competitor comparison, and reputation insights.
- Supports both business-level and individual review text data.
- Structured markdown reports include market benchmarks, rating/review volume tiers, and actionable recommendations.
- Links to [gmapsscraper.io](https://gmapsscraper.io) for easy data export.
